title: Explain a bug to a colleague (B1)
summary: Giải thích một lỗi cho đồng nghiệp trong một phút: triệu chứng, nguyên nhân, cách sửa và cách kiểm tra.
learningObjectives: Mô tả triệu chứng bằng lời đơn giản
Nêu nguyên nhân và cách sửa
Nói cách kiểm tra rằng lỗi đã hết

sections.title: Bug report
sections.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Bug report 214. Title: Wrong total on the cart page. Symptom: when a customer adds two items with a discount code, the total is higher than the sum of the items. Cause found: the discount is applied before the tax is added, but the code adds the tax again afterwards. Fix: apply the tax once, after the discount. Check: a test with two items and one discount code.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Điều người dùng hoặc đội nhìn thấy khi có lỗi.
vocabulary.example: The symptom is a wrong total on the cart page.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Symptom là điều quan sát, không phải nguyên nhân.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Lý do sâu nhất khiến lỗi xảy ra.
vocabulary.example: The root cause was a double tax calculation.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Viết root cause thành hai từ.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Làm lại lỗi theo các bước để nhìn thấy nó.
vocabulary.example: I can reproduce the bug with two items.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Nhấn âm tiết thứ ba: re-pro-DUCE.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Điều từng chạy đúng nhưng hỏng sau một thay đổi.
vocabulary.example: We added a regression test for this case.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Nói a regression test, không nói a regress test.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Thay đổi nhỏ để sửa lỗi.
vocabulary.example: We will ship a patch tomorrow.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Nói apply a patch, không nói do a patch.

expressions.phrase: The symptom is ___. It happens when ___.
expressions.meaning: Mô tả triệu chứng và điều kiện.
expressions.example: The symptom is a wrong total. It happens when a discount code is used.
The root cause was a double tax calculation, because the code added tax twice.

expressions.phrase: To fix it, we ___. This means ___.
expressions.meaning: Nêu cách sửa và ý nghĩa.
expressions.example: To fix it, we apply the tax once. This means the total matches the items.

expressions.phrase: To check, I ___. If ___, the bug is gone.
expressions.example: To check, I run a test with two items. If the total is correct, the bug is gone.

exercises.question: Which order explains a bug clearly?
exercises.explanation: Thứ tự triệu chứng, nguyên nhân, cách sửa, kiểm tra giúp người nghe theo kịp.

exercises.question: Which sentence explains the cause in plain English?
options: The tax is added twice, so the total is too high.
The tax service has a non-idempotent side effect.
It is a race condition in the pricing layer.
correctAnswer: The tax is added twice, so the total is too high.
exercises.explanation: Lời đơn giản nêu rõ chuyện gì xảy ra.

exercises.question: Sửa lỗi: câu "The bug happen when a code is used." sai một từ. Điền dạng đúng thay cho "happen".
exercises.explanation: Chủ ngữ số ít cần happens.

exercises.question: Sắp xếp phần giải thích.
exercises.explanation: Triệu chứng, nguyên nhân, cách sửa, kiểm tra.

sections.title: Ôn lại từ vựng của bài

exercises.question: Ghép từ với nghĩa của nó.
correctAnswer: regression - lỗi do thay đổi mới
exercises.explanation: Ôn lại các từ đã học trong bài này.

exercises.question: Điền từ còn thiếu: The ___ is a wrong total on the cart page.
Điền từ còn thiếu: The ___ was a double tax calculation.
exercises.explanation: "root cause" nghĩa là nguyên nhân gốc.

performanceTask.title: Explain a bug in one minute
performanceTask.scenario: Một đồng nghiệp ở bộ phận khác hỏi vì sao tổng tiền trong giỏ hàng bị sai; bạn giải thích lỗi bằng lời đơn giản.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: Nói bằng tiếng Anh trong khoảng một phút: triệu chứng, nguyên nhân, cách sửa và cách kiểm tra. Chưa xem bài mẫu.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Speak in English for about one minute: explain the symptom, the root cause, the fix and how you will check it.
performanceTask.modelResponse: Let me explain the bug in simple words. The symptom is a wrong total on the cart page. It happens when a customer adds two items and uses a discount code, and then the total is higher than the sum of the items. The root cause was a double tax calculation, because the code applied the discount and then added the tax two times. To fix it, we apply the tax only once, after the discount. This means the total now matches the items on the screen. To check the fix, I run a test with two items and one discount code, and I also add a regression test for this case. If the total is correct, the bug is gone. We plan to ship the patch tomorrow morning.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Explain the bug again in English. Keep the four parts and use simpler words for the cause.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Explain a different bug, such as a report that shows yesterday's data, with the same four parts.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Explain another bug without looking at your old notes.

artifacts.title: Wrong total on the cart page
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Bug report 214. Wrong total on the cart page. Symptom: with two items and a discount code the total is too high. Cause: the tax is added twice. Fix: apply the tax once. Check: a test with two items.

retry.title: Report shows old data
retry.brief: Sửa bài với lỗi báo cáo hiển thị dữ liệu cũ.

artifacts.title: Report shows old data
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Bug report 231. Sales report shows yesterday's numbers. Symptom: the numbers update only after noon. Cause: the report reads a cache that refreshes every twelve hours. Fix: refresh the cache every ten minutes. Check: compare the report with the database.

transfer.title: Emails sent twice
transfer.brief: Tình huống mới: khách nhận hai email.

artifacts.title: Emails sent twice
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Bug report 245. Customers receive two order emails. Symptom: two identical emails within a minute. Cause: the job retries after a timeout even when the first email was sent. Fix: store a send flag per order. Check: force a timeout in a test.

review.title: Search finds nothing
review.brief: Ôn lại với lỗi tìm kiếm không có kết quả.

artifacts.title: Search finds nothing
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Bug report 252. Search returns no results for words with accents. Symptom: searching for the word with an accent shows an empty list. Cause: the index removes accents but the query does not. Fix: normalize the query the same way. Check: a test with accented words.

rubric.label: Four parts in order
rubric.description: Symptom, cause, fix and check in order.

anchors.met: All four parts are easy to find.
anchors.notMet: A part is missing or the order is mixed.

rubric.label: Plain explanation
rubric.description: The cause is explained in words a colleague can follow.

anchors.met: Uses simple words and short sentences for the cause.

rubric.label: Bug vocabulary
rubric.description: Uses words such as symptom, root cause and regression test.

anchors.met: Uses at least three bug-explanation terms.
